lessons.correction: Increase your expansion and production while investing in technology, but ensure you maintain a defensive force to protect your bases.
lessons.mistake: Focusing solely on expanding and teching up while neglecting army production and defense, leaving you vulnerable to enemy aggression.
lessons.recheck: Reassess when you have a strong economy and the opponent's tech direction is clear.
lessons.title: Avoid over-expanding without defense
lessons.when: Early-midgame, when you have a ground-oriented posture with moderate production and light tech, and the opponent is also ground-oriented with heavy production and tech.
lessons.why: A strong economy and tech base will allow you to transition into a powerful midgame army, but only if you survive the early-midgame pressure.

lessons.correction: Maintain your economy and expansion rate while producing queens for defense. Continue teching towards a midgame composition.
lessons.mistake: Being too passive and focusing only on economy and expansion, allowing the Terran to dictate the pace and apply pressure without resistance.
lessons.recheck: Reassess when you have a solid economy and the opponent's tech direction becomes clearer.
lessons.title: Avoid passivity in early game
lessons.when: Early game, when you have a ground-oriented posture with moderate production and light tech, and the opponent is ground-oriented with moderate production and heavy tech.
lessons.why: A strong economy allows you to outproduce the opponent in the midgame. Queens provide cost-effective defense against early pressure and creep spread.

lessons.correction: Increase your technology and production to match the opponent. Continue expanding and strengthening your ground army.
lessons.mistake: Over-investing in technology and upgrades while neglecting army size and scouting, leaving you unprepared for an enemy attack.
lessons.recheck: Reassess when you have a solid army composition and the opponent's tech direction is clear.
lessons.title: Avoid over-investing in tech at the expense of army
lessons.when: Early-midgame, when you have a ground-oriented posture with moderate production and heavy tech, and the opponent is ground-oriented with heavy production and tech.
lessons.why: Investing in technology now allows you to unlock key units like Hydralisks or Roaches, which are essential against a Terran ground army, but you must also maintain a sufficient army to defend.
